themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: Following Flávio Bolsonaro's flight to Florida after his election defeat, right-wing networks in Latin America and the US have aligned to portray his legal troubles as political persecution. The Trump administration granted US visas while Milei's government in Argentina faces severe domestic criticism and judicial scrutiny for allegedly assisting Bolsonaro's transit.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro fled Brazil for Florida via Argentina and Ecuador, claiming election fraud and self-proclaiming as Brazil's legitimate leader from abroad

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's administration faces judicial investigations and opposition criticism for allegedly facilitating Bolsonaro's escape through Argentina

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration welcomed Bolsonaro to Miami, granting US visas despite Brazilian court exit bans and denouncing the election outcome

themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Populist right parties across Europe are celebrating record-breaking polling numbers and expanding local government power. From Norway and Germany to Spain and France, right-wing leaders are capitalizing on voter dissatisfaction with incumbent governments to position themselves as dominant political forces.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple European nations are escalating demands for hardline migration restrictions and the prioritization of native citizens in social services. Leaders frame unchecked migration as a direct threat to national security, housing markets, and public healthcare capacity.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
